Should not be serving Food
Nov 2020 • Couples
Horrible experience at lunch here. Placed my order (CK burger lunch special), 10 mins later, asked to order something else since they ran out. Next ordered Chili Cheese Fries, 30 mins later, asked to change order. Chef decides not to tell the poor waitress there is no more chili while he berated the staff. Felt bad for waitress. Anyways, I just left after paying for an overpriced Sprite since they also ran out of Coke. This is 12:00 on a Sunday. 😂 won’t be going back anytime soon. Warning to all potential diners. Skip it if you are hungry. Terrible service and you will not be fed.

Went for their Monday night STEAK special.
Feb 2018 • Friends
Monday night steak special means you get a free glass of red wine with your steak.
The steak choices are either from USA or Australia. We chose Australian steaks and were not disappointed. Mine was a rib eye with bone attached and my Canadian friend had the special marbled Hokubee beef not too dissimilar to the famous Japanese Wagyu beef with its marbled affect. He ordered medium and I ordered medium rare. Both were perfectly cooked.
Mine was 350k and his cost 450k. We felt value for money due to the high quality of the meat. Came with a side salad of tomato and onion plus potato wedges. There was also a small jug of dark brown gravy with each plate.
I gave them 5 stars purely on the steaks alone.
Nice airy setting beside the canal.

Looks are very deceiving!
Oct 2017
Don’t believe anything you see on the menu... the pictures have nothing to do with the actual food. If you’re looking for a the cheesesteak that is pictured on the menu. Forget about it! If you want a workout for your jaw muscles, get it. Pasta..well...mediocre at best. If it were a sincere effort I would given benefit of the doubt. Gave me 2 menus to order from, when I ordered something from the first menu they said it’s not available because they making food from a new menu; so why give me the other menu if I couldn’t order from it? Wish they would have told me there was only 1 person in the kitchen before I ordered instead of telling 40 mins later after delivering my food. As the local would say... the first time is also the last time. Hope they work it out.

Great food and staff in a nice location overlooking Thi Nghie Canal
Sep 2017 • Solo
I've been here a few times and have had great food and service on every occasion. I must admit I have concentrated on the ribs. I am not a big eater and I can get a serve of American style smoked ribs, salad and chips for 100,000 VND - about $5 USD Top that with cold Tiger bottles for 19,000 VND - about $1.00 USD and they have got me. Big eaters do not despair there are plenty of larger meal options. Great staff, nice location, great food and a great price. I'll definitely be back.
